text.p: Summaries of European Cup matches played on Wednesday:
Pontypridd - Tries: J.Lewis, P.Owen, Simon Enoch (3); Cons: N.Jenkins (2); Pen: Jenkins.
Edinburgh - Try: S.Reed; Con: D.Hodge; Pen: Hodge.
Dax - Tries: F.Tauzin, O.Magne, F.Duberger, U.Mola; Cons: R. Dourthe (3), Tauzin; Pens: Dourthe (2).
Leicester - Tries: A.Kardooni, G.Rowntree; Cons: J.Liley (3); Pens: Liley (2).
Leinster - Try: penalty try; Con: A.McGowan; Pen: McGowan. Scottish Borders beat Llanelli (Wales) 24-16 (halftime 3-9)
Llanelli - Try: A.Richards; Con; F.Botica; Pens: Botica (3).
Neath - Tries: G.Evans, D.Hawkins; Con: G.Davies; Pens: G.Davies (5)
Caledonia - Tries: R.Shepherd, T.Smith. Con: Shepherd, Pens: Shepherd (2)
Harlequins - Tries: M.Watson, D.O'Leary; Con: W.Carling; Pens: Carling (3)
Cardiff - Tries: R.Howley (3), S.Hill, H.Taylor, E.Lewis (3); cons: J.Davies (4)
Munster - Tries: B.Begley, A.Foley; Con: Begley; Pens: Begley (2), K.Keane.
Toulouse - Tries: D.Berty, E.N'Tamack, T.Castaignede, C. Deylaud, J-L Cester, S.Ougier. Cons: Deylaud, Castaignede (3); Pens: Castaignede (2).
Milan - Tries: F.Gomez, P.Cerioni; Cons: D.Dominguez (2); Pens: Dominguez (4).
